description: Common record law for all nine Signature sites. Every governed record carries the 15 core fields; sites add their own specializations without dropping or renaming core fields. governance_status (internal Signature standing) and public_status (outside-world standing) must never be blurred.
determinism_rule: Any generated object is reproducible from id + generator_version + seed/parameters + canonical spec. If it cannot be regenerated bit-for-bit from those, it is not a governed record yet.

canonical_data.description: Exact canonical content the hash is computed over (normalized serialization, not rendered HTML).

generator_version.description: For generated objects: exact generator version.

governance_status.description: Standing inside the Signature system — Manon's own patent-making authority, never a government grant, never USPTO.

hash.description: SHA-256 hex of canonical_data. Any consumer can recompute and verify.

hash_algorithm.description: Hash algorithm. Always SHA-256 in v1.0.

id.description: Permanent deterministic identity, never reused, never silently changed. Per-site format, e.g. JAH-SPEC-000123, JAH-DICT-W-018302, JAHN-TS-000456, JAH-AI-MIX-090112, JAH-EQ-00024301, JAH-PC-00001234, JAH-WIKI-000789, SIGLLAMA-V1.

parent.description: Parent record id this was derived from, or array of parent ids for blends/hybrids. Null for originals.

public_status.description: Standing in the outside world. Strictly separate from governance_status.

related_records.description: IDs of linked records on any of the nine sites (cross-site traceability).

seed.description: For generated objects: seed/parameters enabling bit-for-bit regeneration.

site_extension.description: Per-site specialization fields. Core 15 fields are never dropped or renamed.

source.description: Where the record came from: site + generator + run, e.g. 'signature-one-archive / spec-drip-fill / 2026-10-01'.

version.description: Integer version. A changed record bumps version; id stays the same.

title: Signature Record Standard
verification_rule: Recompute SHA-256 over canonical_data and compare to hash. Downloads ship id, version, and hash so files are verifiable offline.
